batches.brief: Convert units u-invoice-history (OW_BILLING.PKG_INVOICING: COMPUTE_PREVIEW, FN_INVOICE_PREVIEW, FN_INVOICE_LINES, SP_ISSUE_INVOICE) and u-rating (OW_BILLING.PKG_RATING: COMPUTE_RATING, FN_USAGE_RATING, FN_USAGE_SUMMARY, SP_FINALIZE_RATING + trigger TRG_USAGE_EVENTS_CHECK). ONE PR PER UNIT — two PRs against tp-run/databricks-1793185083, one per unit, never combined. Read both units' mapping_spec.json + dependencies.json under .migration/units/. Tenant One only: tenant_id '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' (subscription_id '20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'); the literal stays in converted code, not a manifest param. Naming: write_targets/deploy_objects are logical names under target_namespace; an entry's physical home is its unit's mapping_spec target_kind (u-rating = lakebase, u-invoice-history = Delta); staged copies no routine writes are unit-owned, not write_targets. u-rating lands on the lakebase target: WRITABLE native Lakebase tables (no synced tables) usage_events, rating_periods, rating_results in database ow_tp, project ow-tp-billing, branch mig-1793185083 — load path SELECT-only Python against OW_BILLING_RO_DSN -> CSV -> static DDL CREATE TABLE -> psycopg `COPY ... FROM STDIN` using a per-session OAuth credential via generate-database-credential on the unpooled endpoint host (in target_hosts; the -pooler variant refuses OAuth). No CREATE ROLE. Deploys compute_rating, fn_usage_rating, fn_usage_summary, sp_finalize_rating as same-named Postgres functions plus TRG_USAGE_EVENTS_CHECK as a Postgres trigger enforcing units > 0 and kind_cd against `codes`; confirm `codes` exists in the ow_tp branch as pre-existing reference data; stage it via the same extract path only if absent — say which in the PR. Its SUBSCRIPTIONS/PLANS reads resolve to the wave-1 Lakebase tables in database ow_tp. u-invoice-history lands on the databricks target: Delta tables invoice_header, invoice_line, invoices, invoice_lines, credit_notes in ow_tp.mig_1793185083 — load path SELECT-only extract -> CSV -> `databricks fs cp` to a UC volume under ow_tp.mig_1793185083 -> read_files -> CREATE TABLE AS. Deploys compute_preview, fn_invoice_preview, fn_invoice_lines, sp_issue_invoice as same-named Databricks SQL routines with parity. Cross-target contract: Delta SQL can neither read Lakebase tables nor call Lakebase functions — shared reference tables (subscriptions, plans, tenants, codes) are reads of wave-1 outputs or pre-existing Lakebase data, never wave-2 writes. How the history unit materializes the Delta-side copies its routines need, and how it proves the rating rows SP_ISSUE_INVOICE's inlined SP_FINALIZE_RATING/COMPUTE_RATING logic writes match Oracle, is decided in the run-wave-2 ticket. The Lakebase rating store stays authoritative for rating consumers; recon per unit proves each store against Oracle independently. Source oracle via secret name OW_BILLING_RO_DSN; SELECT only, zero writes. Recon per unit with its own target kind: dbx-recon --family oracle --mode live, tolerance tol-20261027-v1, --target-http-path /sql/1.0/warehouses/565cd2fd713738c4 — u-rating --target-kind lakebase (evidence .migration/recon/u-rating/), u-invoice-history --target-kind databricks (evidence .migration/recon/u-invoice-history/). Gates: recon_pass / recon_pass_rating (row parity), routine_parity / routine_parity_rating (routines match source), rerun_proof / rerun_proof_rating (idempotent rerun).
